propers.name: Secret

taken_from.citation: Missa In medio, de Communi Doctorum [22]

propers.text:
Sancti N. Pontificis tui atque Doctoris nobis, Domine, pia non desit oratio:
quae et munera nostra conciliet; et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Begins on leaf n1365, printed p. 1347, and finishes on leaf n1366, printed p. 1348. The witness prints one Secret with `Pontificis (vel Confessoris)` and `bishop (or confessor)` in the facing columns. This exact row keeps that printed alternative while addressing the 1962 Pontiff branch; it does not silently resolve or compose the parenthesis.

translations.text: May the loving prayers of N., Thy bishop (or confessor), not be wanting to us, O Lord, to commend our gifts and ever to obtain pardon for us. Through our Lord.
